checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Coverage: task 9.3 and M6 are marked ✅ without evidence for most of their scope. tasks.md:66 requires scoped Stryker runs on a fixed list of files ("Target ≥ 95%, minimum 90% (M6)"; "survivors left by earlier changes in these files count too and need tests as well"). The review's own Mutation section says compileCityData.ts, checkCityData.ts, toServedCityData.ts, loadCitySearchData.ts, locationsDocument.ts, createCompositeCitySearch.ts, geoNamesCitySource.ts, zoneCitiesSource.ts, createLocationsActions.ts, compileWithZic.ts, compile.ts and check.ts were not run. It says fetchCitySearch.ts and parseGeoNamesCityData.ts were stopped at 80 of 236 mutants with 2 survivors seen. It never mentions src/model/locations.ts, scripts/cityData/serializeCityDataset.ts or src/controller/useLocations.ts. The 9.3 evidence ("scores measured in this review are all ≥ 90%") and the M6 evidence ("every file measured here is ≥ 90%") do not confirm the task or the metric. Both lines should be ⚠️ (only partly verified, unmeasured files named), and the Summary counts and Verdict text adjusted to match.

findings.message: Severity is too low: task 9.3 is ticked ('- [x] 9.3' in tasks.md:66) and the review marks it ❌ (nine listed files have no score, and the 'kill survivors, re-run' step was not done). The acceptance criteria reserve CRITICAL for 'a ticked-but-undone task', yet R2 is a WARNING, and the Verdict says 'Blocking: R2 ... There is no CRITICAL finding'. R2 should be CRITICAL and the Summary's CRITICAL count updated.

R2's fix does not finish task 9.3: it covers only checkCityCoordinates.ts and checkZoneCoordinates.ts. Two other task-9.3 files the review measured below the 95% target are left out: scripts/zoneRules/compile.ts (90.48%, survivors at lines 44 and 82) and scripts/zoneData/loadCitySearchData.ts (91.67%). Task 9.3 says 'kill survivors, re-run ... Target ≥ 95%', so following the fix leaves 9.3 and M6 unmet.

The Mutation section dismisses the loadCitySearchData.ts survivor at line 50 ('cachedCitySearchData === undefined' → true) as harmless because 'the loaded data is the same'. It is not equivalent: the mutant reloads on every call, and a test counting loads would kill it. Task 9.3 says survivors 'need tests as well'. It needs a finding with a fix, not a dismissal.

The task-9.3 line (review-code.md:52) names only checkCityCoordinates.ts and checkZoneCoordinates.ts as below the 95% target, while the M6 line (:79) lists four such files (also compile.ts and loadCitySearchData.ts). The task line and R2 should cover all four.
